Chargement Dataset Principale + setwd
```{r}
library(readxl)
Data_Globale_Tahiti <- read_excel("Data_Globale_Tahiti.xlsx")
View(Data_Globale_Tahiti)
setwd("~/Césure/Tahiti")
```

```{r}
library(tuneR)
```

Centré_réduire les données pour modélisation, Dataset des sites (n=51), scale des variables nécessaires pour analyses
```{r}
Data_Global_sc <- Data_Globale_Tahiti %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(`Alt`, `P_J_Moy`,`T_Max_M`, `D_B`,`HSA`,`Arb`, `Arbu`, `Her`),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
      .names = "{.col}_sc"
    )
  )
```

Les 4 prédicteursde communauté aviaire avec toutes les végétations, avec deux gaussian et deux binomial, un effet Commune car la variable réponse ne bouge pas sur Enr, et pas de prise en compte de la météo (une moyenne pour un site, peu précis, pas d'hypothèse d'influence possible.
```{r}
mod_S_Hab <- lmer(
  S ~
 `HSA_sc`+`Alt_sc` +`D_B_sc` +`Arb_sc` +`Arbu_sc` +`Her_sc`+(1 | Commune),
  data = Data_Global_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)

mod_SExo_Hab <- lmer(
  S_Exo ~
 `HSA_sc`+`Alt_sc` +`D_B_sc` +`Arb_sc` +`Arbu_sc` +`Her_sc`+(1 | Commune),
  data = Data_Global_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)

mod_PANatif_Hab <- glmer(
  `P/A_Natif` ~
 `HSA_sc`+`Alt_sc` +`D_B_sc` +`Arb_sc` +`Arbu_sc` +`Her_sc`+(1 | Commune),
   family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = Data_Global_sc,
)

mod_PAMyna_Hab <- glmer(
  `P/A_Myna` ~
 `HSA_sc`+`Alt_sc` +`D_B_sc` +`Arb_sc` +`Arbu_sc` +`Her_sc`+(1 | Commune),
   family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = Data_Global_sc,
)
#test de l'ancienne VA de proprotion natif/exotique
mod_NE_Hab <- lmer(
  `N/E` ~
 `HSA(%)` +`Alt(m)` +`D_B(m)` +`Arb(%)` +`Arbu(%)` +`Her(%)`+(1 | Commune),
  data = Data_Global_Scale,
   REML = FALSE
)

summary(mod_S_Hab)
car::Anova(mod_S_Hab)
summary(mod_SExo_Hab)
car::Anova(mod_SExo_Hab)
summary(mod_PANatif_Hab)
car::Anova(mod_PANatif_Hab)
summary(mod_PAMyna_Hab)
car::Anova(mod_PAMyna_Hab)
summary(mod_NE_Hab)
car::Anova(mod_NE_Hab)
```
Exportation des tableaux GLM et Anova, attention a exportée après l'analyse du modèle car même nom de variable entre les modèles tot, arb, arbu et her.
```{r}
models <- list(
  mod_S_Hab = mod_S_Hab,
  mod_SExo_Hab = mod_SExo_Hab,
  mod_PANatif_Hab = mod_PANatif_Hab,
  mod_PAMyna_Hab = mod_PAMyna_Hab
)
format_pvalue <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.0001,
         "0.0001",
         format(round(p, 4), nsmall = 4))
}
add_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.1   ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

table_final <- imap_dfr(models, function(mod, name) {
  
  res <- tidy(mod, effects = "fixed")
  
  # vérifier si df existe
  if(!"df" %in% colnames(res)){
    res$df <- NA
  }
  
  res %>%
    mutate(
      Model = name,
      AIC = round(AIC(mod), 1),
      Estimate = round(estimate, 3),
      Std_Error = round(std.error, 3),
      df = round(df, 2),
      Stat_value = round(statistic, 3),  # z ou t
      p_value = format_pvalue(p.value),
      stars = add_stars(p.value),
      p_display = paste0(p_value, " ", stars)
    ) %>%
    select(Model,
           Community_factor = term,
           AIC,
           Estimate,
           Std_Error,
           df,
           Stat_value,
           p_display)
})
write_xlsx(table_final, "Resultats_Modeles_Hab_Tot.xlsx")
```

```{r}
models <- list(
  mod_S_Hab = mod_S_Hab,
  mod_SExo_Hab = mod_SExo_Hab,
  mod_PANatif_Hab = mod_PANatif_Hab,
  mod_PAMyna_Hab = mod_PAMyna_Hab
)
format_pvalue <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.0001,
         "0.0001",
         format(round(p, 4), nsmall = 4))
}
add_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.1   ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}
anova_table <- imap_dfr(models, function(mod, name) {
  
  aov_res <- car::Anova(mod, type = 2)
  
  as.data.frame(aov_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Community_factor") %>%
    mutate(
      Model = name,
      AIC = round(AIC(mod), 1),
      Chisq = round(Chisq, 3),
      Df = Df,
      p_value = format_pvalue(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      stars = add_stars(`Pr(>Chisq)`),
      p_display = paste0(p_value, " ", stars)
    ) %>%
    select(Model,
           Community_factor,
           AIC,
           Chisq,
           Df,
           p_display)
})
write_xlsx(anova_table, "Resultats_ANOVA_Hab_Total.xlsx")
```

```{r}
mean_arbu <- mean(DF_IA10_sc$`Arbu`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_arbu   <- sd(DF_IA10_sc$`Arbu`, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_alt <- mean(DF_IA10_sc$`Alt`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_alt   <- sd(DF_IA10_sc$`Alt`, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_db <- mean(DF_IA10_sc$`D_B`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_db   <- sd(DF_IA10_sc$`D_B`, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_hsa <- mean(DF_IA10_sc$`HSA`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_hsa   <- sd(DF_IA10_sc$`HSA`, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_S <- mean(DF_IA10_sc$`S`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_S   <- sd(DF_IA10_sc$`S`, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
theme_soundscape <- function() {
  
  theme_minimal() +
    
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#CBD5E1", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    axis.text  = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 12, face = "bold"),

    axis.line = element_line(color = "#64748B", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#64748B"),

    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#64748B"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", face = "bold")
  )
}
```


```{r}
pred_S_Arbu <- ggpredict(
  mod_S_Hab,
  terms = "Arbu_sc [all]"
)


##Graphique
ggplot(pred_S_Arbu, aes(x = x* sd_arbu+mean_arbu, y = predicted)) +
  
  geom_line(size = 1.2, colour = "#334155") +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.35,
    fill = "#94A3B8"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Arbustive cover (%)",
    y = "Predicted Total Richness (±95% CI)"
  ) +
  
  theme_soundscape() 

pred_SExo_Arbu <- ggpredict(
  mod_SExo_Hab,
  terms = "Arbu_sc [all]"
)


##Graphique
ggplot(pred_SExo_Arbu, aes(x = x* sd_arbu+mean_arbu, y = predicted)) +
  
  geom_line(size = 1.2, colour = "#334155") +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.35,
    fill = "#94A3B8"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Arbustive cover (%)",
    y = "Predicted Exotic Richness (±95% CI)"
  ) +
  
  theme_soundscape()

  mod_PANatif_Hab,

)


##Graphique
ggplot(pred_PANatif_Her, aes(x = x* sd_her+mean_her, y = predicted)) +
  
  geom_line(size = 1.2, colour = "#334155") +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.35,
    fill = "#94A3B8"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Herbaceous cover (%)",
    y = "Predicted Presence Absence (±95% CI)"
  ) +
  
  theme_soundscape()
```
